items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: listening to Herbie Hancock and how he plays music

ctx.x: Can you expand on that a little bit, how to be free within the form? What’s the first step of being free?

Well I mean it depends on who you are. Because being free for another musician might be just playing the changes and playing them all perfectly. And that’s free. That’s wonderful. You know, and it depends on who you are. For me being free within the form, you know I actually haven’t figured out how to say it yet, because I do it but I haven’t figured out how to exactly like harness it. Because it’s something that I think we’re all trying to figure out exactly how we want to play the music you know whether it’s…
Well I think that’s sort of the magic of the music is that you can do it but not necessarily put into words what is happening. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
